opening.argument: The program is plainly structured around football questions, answers, and demonstrations: its title identifies Jerry Rice answering football questions, while the field segments show how receiving moves are performed and explain distinctions between running backs and wide receivers. The closing identifies the program as “Football Support,” reinforcing an educational and entertainment format about the sport and its culture. The request to subscribe to WIRED is ordinary channel engagement, presented without any condition involving payment, investment, credentials, or another financial offer.
